programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae Pablo eisiau edrych o gwmpas y siop deganau - mae'r teganau i gyd yn hwylio i fynd i'r gwely am fod y siop ar fîn cau. Pablo enjoys looking around the toy shop but it's about to close.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae Twt yn cynnig cyfeirio traffig yr harbwr i'r Harbwr Feistr, ond cyn hir mae'n draed moch a phawb yn symud i'r cyfeiriad anghywir. Twt offers to help the Harbourmaster direct the traffic.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae Blero eisiau gallu rhedeg ym mhellach ond mae'n mynd yn fyr ei wynt yn hawdd iawn. Blero wants to run further, but he keeps getting out of breath.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Er i Kim a Cêt derbyn help gan Mwydyn, Sioncyn y Gwair, Pry Copyn a'r ystlumod i ddod o hyd iddo, mae Twrch wedi diflannu eto! Twrch has disappeared again.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Dad yn dweud wrth Blwi am fod yn fwy cwrtais wrth y bwrdd bwyd - nid anifeiliaid ydyn nhw! Dad tells Blwi to mind her manners at the table - they're not animals.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae'r amgueddfa'n ddiflas yn ôl Joni, tan bod Beti Bowen yn ceisio dwyn DNA'r mamoth! The museum is boring according to Joni, until Beti Bowen comes to try to steal the DNA of the mammoth.

programme.title: A i Y Awyr Iach
programme.desc: 'c' am 'colomennod' a hefyd 'canwio'. Today's letter is C: 'c' for 'colomennod' (pigeons) and 'canwio' (canoeing).

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae Ger yn dod o hyd i garreg siap seren ac mae Tad-cu yn dweud bydd e'n dod â lwc iddo fe. Ger finds a special star stone which Tad-cu says will bring him luck, and it does - for a while.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Signor Silvo, ffrind Syr Gwil, yn dod ar wyliau i'r parc, ac yn coginio'r pitsa perffaith. Signor Silvo, Syr Gwil's friend, comes on holiday to the park, and cooks the perfect pizza.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Cân llawn egni i helpu plant ddysgu am rannau o'r corff. An energetic song that will help children learn about parts of their body.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r Whws wedi drysu wrth glywed llais rhyfedd yn eu copïo - pwy allai fod? The Woohoos are puzzled when they hear a strange voice copying them - who could it be.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn edrych ar y ffyrdd gwahanol y mae pobl yn cyfathrebu gyda'i gilydd. In this episode we'll look at the different ways people use to communicate with each other.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen yn achub Nel Gynffonwen pan mae Sami a Tomi Broch yn dwyn eu cerbyd. Guto comes to the rescue when Sami and Tomi Broch steals the rabbits' go-kart with Nel on board.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Dewi Sant sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Dewi Sant join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Newyddion i blant hyd at 6 oed a fydd yn diddannu ac yn eu dysgu am y byd o'u cwmpas nhw yn ei holl amrywiaeth. Entertaining and educational news for children up to 6 years old.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae Bobo Gwyn ar ben ei ddigon pan gaiff wahoddiad i edrych ar ôl ceffylau'r Cymylaubychain. Animated series for pre-school children. Bobo Gwyn looks after some horses for a friend.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: 'Sdim stêm yn codi o drên stem Porthmadog - felly ffwrdd a Harri i helpu Owain a gyrrwr y trên. The Steam Train at Porthmadog isn't working. Harri goes to help Owain and the train driver.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Sut mae stopio olwyn ffair rhag dianc? Mae'n rhaid i Mojo a Bo feddwl yn gyflym! How do the gang stop a runaway rolling ferris wheel? they need to act fast.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Pan mae ymdrech Anni i ddod o hyd i sgil newydd yn tarddu ar beiriant compostio newydd Gari, mae iard yr ysgol yn troi'r annibendod llwyr! Anni's efforts to find a new skill causes chaos.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas yn mynd i'r ysgol heddiw. Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop yn gwneud llun gyda phensiliau lliwgar. The Tralalas are going to school today where Harmoni, Melodi & Bop draw a picture.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ond pan mae mam yn chwilio am rhywbeth, mae o'n poeni ac mae'n rhaid i bawb ei helpu i ffeindio 'dim byd'! Everyone helps Pablo find 'nothing'.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae dwr yr harbwr wedi troi'n wyrdd dros nos. Tybed beth yw e a sut y gwnaiff yr Harbwr Feistr cael gwared ohono? The harbour water has turned green overnight. What is causing this.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae Blero'n gweld defaid Ffermwr Ffred yn crwydro o gwmpas Ocido, mae'n casglu nhw ar gyfer cneifo. Blero sees Ffarmwr Ffred's sheep,he rounds them up in time for their annual shearing.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae Twrch yn dwyn holl synau'r goedwig gyda'r Sugnwr Swn a rhaid i Kim a Cêt ddod o hyd iddo a'i stopio. Kim and Cêt have to stop Twrch from stealing all of the forest's sounds.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Blwi, Bingo a Mam yn anghytuno a dadlau gyda Dad ynglyn ag ystyr y gair pryfocio. The girls get into a heated debate with Dad about the definition of the word 'teasing'.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Jini eisiau pen-blwydd ei mam fod yn berffaith, ond gall yr amherffaith fod yn ddigon da? Jini wants her mother's birthday celebrations to be perfect, but can imperfect be good enough.

programme.title: A i Y Awyr Iach

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n benblwydd ar Sioned Siop a sdim bwriad dathlu ganddi, ond ma Dion Diogelwch yn trefnu parti syrpreis iddi! Sioned has no intention of celebrating her birthday but others have plans.

programme.title: Avinash

programme.title: Alag

programme.title: Jungle

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: All mums need some 'me time.' That's why one forward-thinking woman in Kyoto established Mamo Heart, a space for mothers to not only relax, but also get their own business ideas off the ground.

programme.title: Why is Hay Fever Getting Worse?
programme.desc: The number of people suffering from hay fever, which seriously impacts daily life, is increasing worldwide. Behind this trend is a change in pollen dispersal patterns influenced by climate change.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Tsukamoto Yoshiharu (Architect) visits Nara. Long ago, people in Nara preserved ice by building an icehouse on a mountain ridge, showing how architecture can make use of natural characteristics.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: We visit one of Japan's last remaining full-process wedding dress factories and learn about the months of hard work and attention to detail that ensure Japanese brides are beautiful on their big day.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: Oku-Izumo is home to an ancient technique for making the steel used in Japanese swords. We meet a blacksmith who has inherited the tradition, and enjoy local scenery presented in time-lapse images.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with a pianist, Mine Kawakami, for which she plays exclusive pieces, makes you experience each seasons.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Heavy rains and earthquakes can destroy irrigation ponds, increasing flood risk. We'll look at how new technology is utilising fish finders and GPS to support disaster preparedness.

programme.title: Magical Japanese

programme.desc: Showstopping animation about a penguin who can't sing, but whose tap-dancing might just make him a star. Oscar-winning crowd-pleaser with Hugh Jackman and Nicole Kidman.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Pirouetting penguin Mumble is back, fighting to save his melting Antarctic home in this animation. With Elijah Wood, Brad Pitt and Matt Damon. Flashing images.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Pets
programme.desc: When their rivalry leaves them cast adrift on the streets of New York, two squabbling mutts must put their differences aside. Animated adventure.

programme.title: The Secret Life Of Pets 2
programme.desc: Sequel to the hit film about the adventures of our pets that we don't see when we leave home. With the voices of Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford.

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: The story of a magical theme park where the imagination of a little girl named June comes to life. Animated family film with the voices of Mila Kunis and Jennifer Garner.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Woody Allen leads the voice cast as a worker ant desperate to escape colony conformity and woo the beautiful princess. Sharon Stone also voices this animated adventure.

programme.title: Alvin And The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks hit the big time in LA, but will their new-found fame and success make them forget their woodland roots? Family fun with Jason Lee and Justin Long.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: Orphan Luke stumbles onto a witch's plot to rid the world of children. Can he stop their evil scheme? Splendidly scary adaptation of Roald Dahl's novel. Flashing images.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Over the course of several lifetimes a loveable dog tries to figure out what it means to be man's best friend. Family drama with Dennis Quaid.

programme.title: Jack The Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult plays the farmhand who opens up a gateway to a world of hungry giants in this exciting retelling of the beanstalk fairytale.(114mins).

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi and Boo-Boo must save Jellystone Park in this live action version of the classic cartoon. Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake voice the misbehaving bears.(78mins).

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: A cocky fox causes chaos when his poultry pilfering leads the local farmers to dig up his home. Wes Anderson animation with George Clooney. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Pampered bear Boog (Martin Lawrence) teams up with fast-talking deer Elliott (Ashton Kutcher) after becoming stranded in the woods three days before open season. Animation.

programme.title: Penguins Of Madagascar
programme.desc: A group of wisecracking penguins join forces with an undercover organisation to stop a dastardly villain. Animated adventure with the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: The Secret Ninja Force must form an uneasy alliance with the villainous Lord Garmadon when an even greater threat emerges.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge Of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: With a feline superspy plotting world domination, cats and dogs must put their rivalries aside to defeat her. Family fun. Mild violence/flashing images.

programme.title: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob and the gang leap into action when a pirate steals the secret recipe for Krabby Patties. Family adventure. Flashing images.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: A pair of fuzzy-headed trolls embark on a daring rescue mission when members of their tribe are kidnapped. Animation with the voices of Anna Kendrick and Justin Timberlake.

programme.title: Across the Desert
programme.desc: Tafiti, a young meerkat, initially rejects friendship with Bristles, a bush pig. When his grandpa is bitten by a snake, Tafiti sets off to find the flower for the cure.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy about a youngster concerned that his baby brother is actually a power-hungry tycoon sent to destroy his perfect family life.

programme.title: Alvin And The Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: High-pitched fun as the singing rodents take on feisty female furballs The Chipettes in a Battle of the Bands contest. With Anna Faris and Justin Long.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Classic musical about a scrappy young orphan whose life changes overnight when she is taken in by a billionaire. Starring Carol Burnett and the late Albert Finney.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Smash-hit comedy following a single mother on her search for the perfect husband and father to baby Mikey (voiced by Bruce Willis). With John Travolta. Strong language.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Roseanne Barr voices the new addition to Kirstie Alley and John Travolta's family, and is just as opinionated as her toddler brother, voiced by Bruce Willis. Comedy sequel.

programme.title: Die Alone
programme.desc: A man with amnesia teams up with a tough survivalist during a zombie-like outbreak. Together, they navigate dangers and search for the amnesiac's missing girlfriend.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Set in Mexico in the early 1900s, this action-packed movie tells of the birth of vampire princess Santanico Pandemonium.

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: A clairvoyant therapist confronts her own personal demons while trying to save a young girl who believes a malevolent entity is feeding on her.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.
